# Do not restart a notification telemetry interval for the same logical ID

updatedNotifications returns when the current ID still matches the candidate, even when JSON parsing supplies a new object. That preserves its selected timestamp and avoids another shown event. The telemetry regression test waits over a second, supplies a new object with the same ID, verifies no extra shown event and then checks duration on dismissal. Preserve logical identity separately from JavaScript object identity for this update path. The test's controlled delay measures the duration contract; it was not run here.

Scope: Notification telemetry identity across refreshed objects.
